spans.opaque: main opaque pass (opaque, alpha mask, skybox)
spans.post: bloom, depth of field and tonemapping (ends after tonemapping)
spans.prepass: depth/normal/motion prepass, depth downsample, late (occlusion) passes
spans.preprocess: GPU mesh preprocessing: uniform allocation, culling, indirect args
spans.shadow: early directional and point shadow passes
spans.ssao: after the Prepass set until MainPass: SSAO, main indirect args
spans.transmission: main transmissive pass: screen copy plus refracting water (Medium and up)
spans.transparent: main transparent pass (alpha-blended water on Low) and other MainPass work
